name: Question 12
problem:
Consider the curve defined parametrically as 

$$
x={e}^{t}-t,\,y=4{e}^{t/2},\,t\in [0,1].
$$

Calculate the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $y$-axis.

Question 12

Consider the curve defined parametrically as x=et−t,y=4et/2,t∈[0,1]. Calculate the surface area generated when this curve is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis.

a
 (2e2−e+3)π
b
 (e2+6e)π
c
 (e2+3e−1)π
d
 (e2−3)π
e
 (e2+2e−6)π
